span_text: In addition, if Landlord fails to perform any material obligation under this Lease and such failure continues uncured for thirty (30) days after written notice from Tenant specifying the nature of such failure, Tenant shall have the right to draw upon the Security Deposit as a setoff against damages, and if such failure continues for an additional thirty (30) days, Tenant may terminate this Lease upon written notice to Landlord.

span_text: If the damage cannot be restored within two hundred forty (240) days, or if the damage occurs during the last twelve (12) months of the Term and the cost of restoration exceeds fifty percent (50%) of the replacement value of the Building, either party may terminate this Lease upon sixty (60) days' written notice given within ninety (90) days of the damage.
